description: START HERE. Returns AI-agent businesses with sourced, dated revenue: briefs (slug, name, category, tier, one_liner, annualized_revenue_usd, basis, confidence, url_profile) + total + next page. Example: {"query":"support","limit":3} -> 3 customer-support agents with their sourced revenue. Empty query = all, highest revenue first; filters category, tier, verified_only; limit max 50, offset/cursor. Next: get_business {"slug"}. Cost: free (100 calls/day without a key). Past 100/day: $0.005 per call via x402 (no signup).

category.description: Category slug, e.g. coding-agents, customer-support (see list_categories).

cursor.description: Opaque page token: page.next_cursor from the previous call with the same query and filters.

offset.description: Skip this many matches (page start). Default 0. Use page.next_offset from the previous call.

tier.description: Funding-based, not size-based: venture = raised outside venture money (even if small), indie = bootstrapped/founder-funded, experiment = agent-run or research project.

verified_only.description: Keep only businesses whose headline figure is payment-processor verified (headline_verification not null).

name: search_businesses

page.description: Pagination: call again with offset = next_offset (or cursor = next_cursor) while has_more.

headline_verification.description: How the headline figure is verified: {method, processor, via} for payment-connected figures, else null.

signup_go_url.description: Same link via mrrledger.com/go/<slug> (counts the click, then 302)

signup_url.description: Referral link (only on businesses with one). Always shown with signup_url_disclosure; never affects figures, ranking, sorting or verification.

title: Search businesses (start here)
